shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with circular/rosette-like motifs and some horizontal banding, and both include figural elements, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single free-standing, heavily eroded block with a vertical, roughly symmetrical arrangement of large isolated motifs, whereas B is an extended wall in crisp, finely detailed registers filled with a repeating horizontal procession of standing figures — utterly different in composition, scale of detail and finish.
